say:1:1220601001:1.text: Stay still, Barbara, I'm trying to treat your wound.
say:1:1220601001:1.source_cn: 芭芭拉，别乱动，我现在为你处理伤口。

say:3:1220601002:0.text: What'd I say? Didn't I tell you I'd teach those rotten snakes a lesson? And—ohh, be gentle, dear.
say:3:1220601002:0.source_cn: 怎么样？我和你说过我会教训那群臭混蛋！嘶……轻点，亲爱的。

say:5:1220601003:1.text: Bear with me, gentleness is a luxury I can't afford with so many others waiting for treatment.
say:5:1220601003:1.source_cn: 忍着点，我可没时间轻手轻脚，伤员都在排队呢。

say:6:1220601004:1.text: Excuse me, <male>Sir</male>, can you do me a favor?
say:6:1220601004:1.male: Excuse me, <male>Sir</male>, can you do me a favor?
say:6:1220601004:1.female: Excuse me, <female>Miss</female>, can you do me a favor?

choice_prompt:7:1220601004.text: Excuse me, <male>Sir</male>, can you do me a favor?
choice_prompt:7:1220601004.source_cn: 嘿，这位<male>先生</male><female>女士</female>，帮个忙好吗？
choice_prompt:7:1220601004.male: Excuse me, <male>Sir</male>, can you do me a favor?
choice_prompt:7:1220601004.female: Excuse me, <female>Miss</female>, can you do me a favor?

say:8:1220601005:1.text: Could you pass me that bandage just there?
say:8:1220601005:1.source_cn: 麻烦把旁边的绷带递给我。
say:8:1220601005:1.male: Could you pass me that bandage just there?
say:8:1220601005:1.female: Could you pass me that bandage just there?

choice_prompt:9:1220601005.text: Could you pass me that bandage just there?
choice_prompt:9:1220601005.source_cn: 麻烦把旁边的绷带递给我。
choice_prompt:9:1220601005.male: Could you pass me that bandage just there?
choice_prompt:9:1220601005.female: Could you pass me that bandage just there?

say:10:1220601006:1.text: Many thanks. There are so many injured I can barely manage them all.
say:10:1220601006:1.source_cn: 噢，谢谢。伤员太多了，我一个人实在是忙不过来。
say:10:1220601006:1.male: Many thanks. There are so many injured I can barely manage them all.
say:10:1220601006:1.female: Many thanks. There are so many injured I can barely manage them all.

say:11:1220601007:1.text: I know this is a lot to ask, kind Sir, but would you be willing to search for my daughter? When the Water Wights came, I had her <style="highlight">hide in the forest</style>.
say:11:1220601007:1.source_cn: 好心人，能拜托你去找找我女儿吗？水鬼帮来的时候我让她<...
say:11:1220601007:1.male: I know this is a lot to ask, kind Sir, but would you be willing to search for my daughter? When the Water Wights came, I had her <style="highlight">hide in the forest</style>.
say:11:1220601007:1.female: I know this is a lot to ask, kind Miss, but would you be willing to search for my daughter? When the Water Wights came, I had her <style="highlight">hide in the forest</style>.

say:12:1220601008:1.text: I'm worried sick because she hasn't returned yet. But as you can see, there are still many here who need my care.
say:12:1220601008:1.source_cn: 但她现在都没回来，我很担心。但你瞧，这里还有这么多人需要我。
say:12:1220601008:1.male: I'm worried sick because she hasn't returned yet. But as you can see, there are still many here who need my care.
say:12:1220601008:1.female: I'm worried sick because she hasn't returned yet. But as you can see, there are still many here who need my care.

choice_prompt:13:1220601008.text: I'm worried sick because she hasn't returned yet. But as you can see, there are still many here who need my care.
choice_prompt:13:1220601008.source_cn: 但她现在都没回来，我很担心。但你瞧，这里还有这么多人需要我。
choice_prompt:13:1220601008.male: I'm worried sick because she hasn't returned yet. But as you can see, there are still many here who need my care.
choice_prompt:13:1220601008.female: I'm worried sick because she hasn't returned yet. But as you can see, there are still many here who need my care.

say:14:1220601009:1.text: She takes after her lousy, stubborn father in many ways; my over-caring might just upset her.
say:14:1220601009:1.source_cn: 她的性格很像她的混蛋爸爸，过多的关心可能反而会引起她的反感。
say:14:1220601009:1.male: She takes after her lousy, stubborn father in many ways; my over-caring might just upset her.
say:14:1220601009:1.female: She takes after her lousy, stubborn father in many ways; my over-caring might just upset her.

say:15:1220601010:1.text: Sometimes navigating the dynamics between a mother and daughter is more complex than surgery...
say:15:1220601010:1.source_cn: 有时候……母女关系比你想的要更复杂。
say:15:1220601010:1.male: Sometimes navigating the dynamics between a mother and daughter is more complex than surgery...
say:15:1220601010:1.female: Sometimes navigating the dynamics between a mother and daughter is more complex than surgery...

choice_prompt:16:1220601010.text: Sometimes navigating the dynamics between a mother and daughter is more complex than surgery...
choice_prompt:16:1220601010.source_cn: 有时候……母女关系比你想的要更复杂。
choice_prompt:16:1220601010.male: Sometimes navigating the dynamics between a mother and daughter is more complex than surgery...
choice_prompt:16:1220601010.female: Sometimes navigating the dynamics between a mother and daughter is more complex than surgery...

say:17:1220601011:1.text: Sigh, if only she could understand as easily as you.
say:17:1220601011:1.source_cn: 唉，真希望她也能这么理解我。
say:17:1220601011:1.male: Sigh, if only she could understand as easily as you.
say:17:1220601011:1.female: Sigh, if only she could understand as easily as you.

say:18:1220601012:1.text: You have my thanks. My daughter should be hiding in the small grove <style="highlight">behind the village</style>. Please bring her home safely.
say:18:1220601012:1.male: You have my thanks. My daughter should be hiding in the small grove <style="highlight">behind the village</style>. Please bring her home safely.
say:18:1220601012:1.female: You have my thanks. My daughter should be hiding in the small grove <style="highlight">behind the village</style>. Please bring her home safely.

say:0:1220602001:0.text: Let's go look behind the village.
say:0:1220602001:0.source_cn: 走吧，咱们去村子后面找找。

say:0:1220603001:0.text: This must be the small grove.
say:0:1220603001:0.source_cn: 小树林，应该就是这里了吧。

say:1:1220604001:1.text: Stop right there! Come any closer and I won't be taking any prisoners!
say:1:1220604001:1.source_cn: 站住！再敢靠近一步，我就不客气了！

say:3:1220604002:1.text: Go on then, do your worst.

say:5:1220604004:1.text: Ha! That all you can muster up? This is beyond pathetic.
say:5:1220604004:1.source_cn: 噢，就这么点力气吗？这种力道也算打人？真让人发笑。

say:7:1220604005:1.text: Quit jawing and grab what's in her hands! It's worth a ton!
say:7:1220604005:1.source_cn: 别跟她废话了，她手里的东西很不错，抢过来！

say:8:1220604006:0.text: Let me go! You slimy pack of toads!

choice_prompt:9:1220604006.text: Let me go! You slimy pack of toads!

say:10:1220604007:0.text: Who are you? Did you come all this way just to turn out your pockets for us?
say:10:1220604007:0.source_cn: 你是谁啊？专门跑来给咱兄弟送钱吗？
say:10:1220604007:0.male: Who are you? Did you come all this way just to turn out your pockets for us?
say:10:1220604007:0.female: Who are you? Did you come all this way just to turn out your pockets for us?

say:11:1220604009:0.text: Wow! Look at that swanky getup <male>he's</male> got on and the funny-looking rats next to him! What a catch we've got here!
say:11:1220604009:0.male: Wow! Look at that swanky getup <male>he's</male> got on and the funny-looking rats next to him! What a catch we've got here!
say:11:1220604009:0.female: Wow! Look at that swanky getup <female>she's</female> got on and the funny-looking rats next to her! What a catch we've got here!

say:13:1220604010:0.text: You cheeky knaves! Bite those rude tongues!
say:13:1220604010:0.source_cn: 你们这些坏人，不得无礼！

say:15:1220604011:0.text: Magister! We've got to show them who's boss! Let's see who's really the scaredy 'rats' here!
say:15:1220604011:0.source_cn: 主人，我们给这群家伙点颜色看看！
say:15:1220604011:0.male: Magister! We've got to show them who's boss! Let's see who's really the scaredy 'rats' here!
say:15:1220604011:0.female: Magister! We've got to show them who's boss! Let's see who's really the scaredy 'rats' here!

choice:9:0:1.text: You heard the girl. Stop at once.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 喂，那个女孩让你们住手
choice:9:0:1.male: You heard the girl. Stop at once.
choice:9:0:1.female: You heard the girl. Stop at once.

say:0:1220605101:0.text: Thank you, but... who are you?

say:3:1220606002:1.text: But... you used magic just now, didn't you? You seem more like a mage than a captain.
say:3:1220606002:1.source_cn: 但是……你刚才用的是魔法吧？比起船长，你更像是个魔法师。
say:3:1220606002:1.male: But... you used magic just now, didn't you? You seem more like a mage than a captain.
say:3:1220606002:1.female: But... you used magic just now, didn't you? You seem more like a mage than a captain.

say:5:1220606006:1.text: You should hurry back to the village. Chippy bet your mother is very worried about you.
say:5:1220606006:1.source_cn: 快点回村子吧，你的妈妈很担心你。

say:6:1220606007:1.text: Alright... I've been out long enough. Let me just get my bag... Oh no!
say:6:1220606007:1.source_cn: 好吧……我出来得也够久了，等我拿上我的小包……天呐！

say:8:1220606009:1.text: Those slimy Water Wights! They... they just ripped up the star map from my bag!
say:8:1220606009:1.source_cn: 这些该死的水鬼！他们……他们刚才扯坏了我包里的星座图！

say:9:1220606010:1.text: I spent so many nights under the stars drawing it... *sniffle*... How could they?
say:9:1220606010:1.source_cn: 那是我花了好多个晚上，对着星空一笔一笔画出来的……呜呜……

choice_prompt:10:1220606010.text: I spent so many nights under the stars drawing it... *sniffle*... How could they?
choice_prompt:10:1220606010.source_cn: 那是我花了好多个晚上，对着星空一笔一笔画出来的……呜呜……

say:12:1220606012:1.text: The Magister is the best person to have a try!
say:12:1220606012:1.source_cn: 让主人试试看吧，主人可厉害呢！
say:12:1220606012:1.male: The Magister is the best person to have a try!
say:12:1220606012:1.female: The Magister is the best person to have a try!

choice:10:0:1.text: Maybe I can help you fix it.
choice:10:0:1.male: Maybe I can help you fix it.
choice:10:0:1.female: Maybe I can help you fix it.

choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 我是最传奇最伟大的船长

say:15:1220606003:1.text: Ugh, that's the last thing I wanted to hear. She's so overprotective!
say:15:1220606003:1.source_cn: 噢，我最不希望听到的就是这句话，她总是过度操心。
say:15:1220606003:1.male: Ugh, that's the last thing I wanted to hear. She's so overprotective!
say:15:1220606003:1.female: Ugh, that's the last thing I wanted to hear. She's so overprotective!

say:17:1220606004:1.text: But your mother's instincts were correct. You were in quite a bit of danger just now.
say:17:1220606004:1.source_cn: 但是你妈妈的担心是对的，不然刚才你会有危险。

say:18:1220606005:1.text: Oh, she's always correct... I just don't like it.
say:18:1220606005:1.source_cn: 她总是对的，只是我单纯不喜欢这样。

choice:2:1:2.text: Your mother sent us for you.
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 你妈妈请我们找你回家
choice:2:1:2.male: Your mother sent us for you.
choice:2:1:2.female: Your mother sent us for you.

say:1:1220607001:1.text: It's fixed! You really did it! This has to be some kind of magic!
say:1:1220607001:1.source_cn: 修复了！你真的……做到了！这……这一定是魔法吧！
say:1:1220607001:1.male: It's fixed! You really did it! This has to be some kind of magic!
say:1:1220607001:1.female: It's fixed! You really did it! This has to be some kind of magic!

say:2:1220607002:1.text: You all... you're truly the greatest, most legendary, most heroic, and most adorable mages in all of Esperia!
say:2:1220607002:1.source_cn: 你们……你们简直就是伊索米亚最伟大、最传奇、最英气、最...

choice_prompt:3:1220607002.text: You all... you're truly the greatest, most legendary, most heroic, and most adorable mages in all of Esperia!
choice_prompt:3:1220607002.source_cn: 你们……你们简直就是伊索米亚最伟大、最传奇、最英气、最可爱的魔法师！

say:4:1220607003:1.text: No... you have no idea how important this is to me...
say:4:1220607003:1.source_cn: 不……你不清楚这对我来说有多重要……
say:4:1220607003:1.male: No... you have no idea how important this is to me...
say:4:1220607003:1.female: No... you have no idea how important this is to me...

say:5:1220607005:1.text: My father, a great helmsman, promised me he would return every year and almost always kept that promise.
say:5:1220607005:1.source_cn: 我的爸爸……是个经验丰富的舵手，他答应过我每年都会回来...

say:6:1220607006:1.text: When I was little, I asked him what would happen if he got lost and couldn't find his way back home.
say:6:1220607006:1.source_cn: 在我很小的时候问过他，如果他找不到回家的路怎么办。

say:7:1220607007:1.text: He said that as long as you can read the stars, you'll never lose your way.
say:7:1220607007:1.source_cn: 他告诉我，只要看懂天上的星座，就永远不会迷路。

say:8:1220607008:1.text: But the ship he was steering never came back...
say:8:1220607008:1.source_cn: 但后来有一天，他掌舵的那艘船再也没回来……

choice_prompt:9:1220607008.text: But the ship he was steering never came back...
choice_prompt:9:1220607008.source_cn: 但后来有一天，他掌舵的那艘船再也没回来……

say:10:1220607009:1.text: No... it's alright. I've already... stopped being so sad.
say:10:1220607009:1.source_cn: 不不，没什么，我已经……不难过了。
say:10:1220607009:1.male: No... it's alright. I've already... stopped being so sad.
say:10:1220607009:1.female: No... it's alright. I've already... stopped being so sad.

say:12:1220607011:1.text: So you made this star map to honor your father?
say:12:1220607011:1.source_cn: 所以，你画这张星座图式为了纪念你爸爸？

say:13:1220607012:1.text: That's right, but it's also for my future.
say:13:1220607012:1.source_cn: 嗯，是的，但也是为了我的未来。

say:14:1220607013:1.text: After my father's accident, my mother seemed to completely change. She never let me go far from home and won't listen to any talk of me becoming a helmsman.
say:14:1220607013:1.source_cn: 父亲遇难后，妈妈就像变了个人一样，不再愿意我成为一名舵...

say:15:1220607014:1.text: The truth is, your mother is afraid of losing you...
say:15:1220607014:1.source_cn: 其实，你妈妈只是害怕失去你……

say:16:1220607015:1.text: I get it, but I've grown up now. I can't spend my whole life huddled behind her skirt like a child.
say:16:1220607015:1.source_cn: 我明白，可我已经长大了，不能像个小孩子，缩在妈妈身边度...

say:17:1220607016:1.text: I want to steer my own destiny, just as a helmsman steers a ship!
say:17:1220607016:1.source_cn: 我想要掌控自己的未来，就像舵手掌控船的方向！

say:18:1220607017:1.text: I want to set sail and come back with loads of treasures. As long as I can read the stars, I'll always find my way!
say:18:1220607017:1.source_cn: 决定了去哪里后就出航，有了收获就满载而归——只要看懂天...

say:20:1220607018:1.text: You are the helmsman of your own future—you can definitely do it!
say:20:1220607018:1.source_cn: 决定自己未来的舵手——你一定能做到的！

say:21:1220607019:1.text: And I will! Thanks a lot! I should head back home now.
say:21:1220607019:1.source_cn: 我会的！谢谢你们，我该回去了。

say:22:1220607020:1.text: Um... will we meet again someday?
say:22:1220607020:1.source_cn: 那个……我们以后还会再见面吗？

choice_prompt:23:1220607020.text: Um... will we meet again someday?
choice_prompt:23:1220607020.source_cn: 那个……我们以后还会再见面吗？

say:24:1220607021:1.text: Great! I'll keep studying navigation, and maybe someday you'll board a ship I'm sailing!
say:24:1220607021:1.source_cn: 那太好了！我会继续学习导航，也许未来有一天，你会乘上我...
say:24:1220607021:1.male: Great! I'll keep studying navigation, and maybe someday you'll board a ship I'm sailing!
say:24:1220607021:1.female: Great! I'll keep studying navigation, and maybe someday you'll board a ship I'm sailing!

say:27:1220607022:1.text: I'll pray to the gods that we do!
say:27:1220607022:1.male: I'll pray to the gods that we do!
say:27:1220607022:1.female: I'll pray to the gods that we do!

say:28:1220607010:1.text: Sorry, that's not what I meant to say.
say:28:1220607010:1.source_cn: 对不起，我要说的不是这些。
say:28:1220607010:1.male: Sorry, that's not what I meant to say.
say:28:1220607010:1.female: Sorry, that's not what I meant to say.

choice:3:0:1.text: That was easy as pie, don't worry.
choice:3:0:1.male: That was easy as pie, don't worry.
choice:3:0:1.female: That was easy as pie, don't worry.

choice:3:1:2.text: Is the star map that important?
choice:3:1:2.male: Is the star map that important?
choice:3:1:2.female: Is the star map that important?
